dartFlutterProbe.reason: The canonical packages/entity_graph_flutter package resolved its committed lockfile offline, passed dart analyze with zero issues, and passed all 54 Flutter tests in a separate pristine copy. Dart 3.13 formatting would change six source/test files, Flutter 3.47 beta adds platform/build exclusions to analysis_options.yaml, and Riverpod 3.3.2 is newer than the pinned 2.6.1. Those runtime, formatting, manifest, and dependency migrations belong to v3-dart-graph-riverpod; none was silently applied here.

melos.reason: No melos.yaml exists yet. Introducing the Dart workspace and its aggregate commands belongs to v3-dart-graph-riverpod.

cargo.reason: This provenance change owns no Rust source, Cargo manifest, Tauri capability, generated binding, or native command behavior. Native Cargo and device gates remain with the Tauri desktop/mobile changes.

docusaurus.reason: The planned website directory does not exist yet. Documentation foundation, branded content, visual certification, and GitHub Pages changes retain site build, link, accessibility, and deployment gates.

visual.reason: The deterministic lineage SVG and reviewed PNG prove source flow and are hash-bound. They explicitly do not claim Flutter rendering, device behavior, or accessibility certification; those remain with the Flutter showcase.
